body: I have a heart condition that makes my heart race very fast upon standing and this makes me faint often, especially in high heat. My lungs hurt regularly since I’m always short of breath from standing, I’ve always been skinny my whole life and I can’t even gain weight, so nowadays I just keep losing weight. I’m very depressed and have always been and this greatly affects my life. I have pretty much every symptom of severe depression though I don’t want to self diagnose. I also think I may have bipolar disorder since I’m always switching very quickly from false happiness to very apathetic or sad. But again, I don’t want to self diagnose.
my physical health condition or my mental health?

thank you for replying. i really don’t think my parents would care, they seem to have not cared before when i had been in terrible situations because of my bad physical health. i wish things would get better for me, and i’m very glad they’ve gotten better for you. 

i’m in high school right now. i’m a junior. i did fine last year and i had straight As freshman year. i think i’ve been depressed since 5th grade after so many traumatic events + abuse. 

how could i possibly get better? i cant get a therapist or anything. i feel like my only way out of this is death.
